main.play: static: hold this frame while frozen

snap.play: optional one-shot on attach, then switch to main

anchor.meaning: Enemy body centre. Draw each frame with this pixel on the enemy position (e.x, e.y).

scaleRule: drawScale = LST.StatusLook.bodyR(e) / refBodyR (world units per sheet px); i.e. draw the frame at frame.w * bodyR/88 world units wide. Same art for every enemy type, no tint.

shellBottom.meaning: bottom of the ice shell = body bottom + 0.15*refBodyR

alpha: shell fill is see-through (about 50% alpha); ink, snow and glint are solid

provenance.postProcess: _tools/process.py (key, un-mix, cut, scale x0.5627, register, strip); see-through alpha from colour class
provenance.license: Original generated art made for Brian Awsumb's Last Stand Tower; no third-party packs or licensed sheets.
provenance.prompt: 4-frame 2x2: rounded ice-cube shell, snow cap with wavy drip edge, glint; frames 1-3 snap-on, frame 4 final.
